name: New Birth The
overview: The New Birth is a divine transformation where God renews the heart and spirit of His people, removing the hardness of sin and imparting a heart of flesh to enable true love for Him, as seen in Deuteronomy 30:6 and Ezekiel 36:26. This spiritual renewal includes a circumcision of the heart and a new spirit within, leading to a genuine knowledge of God and a restored relationship as His people, demonstrated in Jeremiah 24:7 and Ezekiel 11:19. Ultimately, this new creation is designed for God's glory, reflecting His will and mercy, as He forms and calls His children from all nations for His purpose (Isaiah 43:6-7).
